subject: Interview orchestration: Lead Inference Engineer — panel schedule & bar-raiser guidance
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@talentbridge.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Interview orchestration: Lead Inference Engineer — panel schedule & bar-raiser guidance

Team —

Quick thread to align on the panel and what we expect from the bar-raiser for the Lead Inference Engineer (runtime/serving) hire. Alex Zhao (candidate) is confirmed for week of Feb 22; Sarah from TalentBridge is coordinating final slots (cc).

Top asks:
- Confirm who can be on the panel and which segments they own (system design, runtime performance, production tradeoffs, behavioral/culture).
- Lock the bar-raiser role and the specific pass/fail signals we’ll use.
- Share question bank + scoring rubric (I attached a draft).

Ideal panel (proposed):
- Lauren: system design + production architecture (45m)
- Marissa: runtime/throughput/latency probes + inference cost tradeoffs (30m)
- Rishi: culture/leadership + incident handling (30m)
- Bar-raiser: (Rishi preferred) — review overall fit and edge-case probes; final veto/raise conversation in debrief (15m)

Please confirm availability and whether you want different ownership. I’ve attached a concise question bank and a scoring rubric for quick review. I’ll create the candidate calendar block after we confirm.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Hiring Manager, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference

---

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@talentbridge.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interview orchestration: Lead Inference Engineer — panel schedule & bar-raiser guidance

Thanks Aditya — I can cover system design + latency/cost tradeoffs but would prefer 60m for architecture deep-dive and 30m split with Marissa on runtime knob questions.

Suggested focus areas for my block:
- Designing a multi-tenant serving runtime with predictable p99 latency (tradeoffs: batching vs tail latency).
- Failure isolation: how would they contain KV cache corruption or slow hosts during rollout?
- Observability: what minimal instrumentation would you add to detect regression after a model rollout?

Also: for leveling, I want to ensure we separate "individual contributor lead" expectations vs "people manager" signals. The rubric should call out scope (cross-team influence, ownership of infra primitives, mentoring).

-Lauren
Principal Engineer

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interview orchestration: Lead Inference Engineer — panel schedule & bar-raiser guidance

Folks — attaching an updated panel-question-bank.pdf (shortlist) and the scoring rubric spreadsheet. Highlights I edited:
- Runtime questions include a short live exercise: candidate to sketch an autoscaling policy and explain KV cache strategy for low-cost long-sequence prompts.
- Scoring: each section has a 1-4 anchor: 1 (insufficient), 2 (meets core), 3 (strong), 4 (exceptional). For this role, we weight system design and runtime 40% each, leadership/behavior 20%.

I also added a "red flags" column — e.g., inability to reason about tail-latency mitigation, no track record of shipping infra features, or evasive answers about postmortems.

If you’re good with this, I’ll finalize and upload to the shared debrief doc.

Marissa
Sr. Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime

Attachments: panel-question-bank.pdf (15 pages, excerpted), lead-inference-scoring-rubric.xlsx (1 sheet)

---

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:36:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interview orchestration: Lead Inference Engineer — panel schedule & bar-raiser guidance

Happy to take bar-raiser on this loop. A few calibration notes:
- Bar-raiser role is to protect hiring bar, not to be a blocking micromanager. I’ll focus on cross-company scope, pattern recognition (have they shipped infra features at multiple scale inflection points?), and coaching signals.
- For leveling: require at least two anchors where candidate has influenced cross-team product/infra decisions or run one major rollout end-to-end.
- For scoring: recommend we convert the 1-4 anchors into quick yes/no pass flags in the debrief for final vote (e.g., system-design-pass: yes/no; runtime-pass: yes/no; manager-influence-pass: yes/no). This reduces ambiguity in close calls.

One ask: can we keep the debrief meeting immediately after the interview (30m) and have everyone bring their filled rubric? I’ll chair the debrief.

Rishi
Staff Engineer — Serving
